The event that k is last is the event of visiting both endpoints [k-n+1,k-1] before either adjacent lift of k. The strong Markov decomposition yields equation (2), then direct even/odd substitution yields every displayed probability, including endpoint cases. The finite cycle covers almost surely. The embedded independent absorbing-chain solver checks the model exactly at 20580 rational test assertions in total, but the universal theorem relies on the proof, not enumeration.
